items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: He made some records with Wild Bill, you know. Yeah, Wild Bill did. He played with the band.

ctx.x: Yeah. I heard his records, anyway. Huh?

He made some records with Wild Bill, you know. Yeah, Wild Bill did. He played with the band. That's right. Maury Stein, the writer on Hollywood, was writing a lot of tunes, you know. He writes a lot of tunes.
Uh-huh. Before I forget it, how did George Bernays get his first trombone?
